rationale: The diff spans three Workflows UI changes — (1) WorkflowCanvas.vue branch-arm connector geometry, (2) WorkflowNode.vue status-badge flex-wrap/max-width layout, (3) WorkflowsList.vue resume-action variant ghost->ghost-success. No existing Workflows spec covers any of these: workflows-crud/negative cover CRUD/validation, workflows-conditions covers the Condition node, workflows-delivery covers destination sinks, workflows-incidents covers the incident trigger. The Branch node itself has NO E2E coverage at all, and neither the badge strip nor the list pause/resume control is asserted anywhere. These are a single cohesive 'canvas branch connectors & control polish' feature in the Workflows area, so a new spec (per run-context spec_path) is the least-duplicative choice. NOTE: the Workflows shard is NOT present in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (grep returns nothing) — existing Workflows specs register in the enterprise ci_matrix.ent.json (outside this repo, per the workflowsPage.js header comment). The Engineer should register this spec in that enterprise matrix, not in the OSS ci_matrix.json.
